Use case: sketch-to-render. Photorealistic architectural interior design visualization for one real apartment. Image 1 is the ONLY geometry, position, camera and object-count anchor: preserve its room boundaries, openings, floor layout, perspective or spherical projection, and exact furniture arrangement. Image 2 is ONLY a photographic quality and light reference: transfer the believable daylight bounce, controlled contrast, soft-edged sun shadows, fine wood grain, realistic linen fibres and specular reflections. Do not copy its layout or UI. Style: clean natural modern Japanese, matte warm-white walls and ceiling, pale oak flooring and coffee/office tops, limited medium-dark chocolate walnut, sage green and navy accents. Keep the original milk-yellow lower corridor doors and cream-white uppers. TV wall extremely plain; no decorative TV panels. No main central living chandelier. Preserve the quiet complete suspended ceiling, the lower corridor AC service band and its slim white grilles where visible, hidden curtain cove, restrained cabinet/task lighting, fine door reveals and rounded exposed ends. New warm-grey low woven rug remains exactly under the living furniture. Laundry at the window-right end is an OPEN-front stacked washer/dryer niche with a flush upper cabinet; do not cover the machines with full-height doors or remove their cabinet. Desk behind sofa faces the TV, one 34-inch monitor, ONE office chair. Its near-end solid warm-white halfwall meets the bookcase, capped in walnut; balcony end must remain OPEN without cross rail or end cabinet. Dining has a white two-door refrigerator OUTSIDE the continuous walnut U, a flush cabinet face, opaque upper doors and R100 white outer end, four horizontal stages including the shallow walnut band and continuous open niche, U counter all at one 880mm level. NO dining chairs or stools in this revision. Entry keeps pale wood piano-key hooks and bench on the entering person's left, and white shoe storage on the right. Balcony keeps ONE low round tea table and exactly TWO low tea chairs. Preserve item counts. Replace the crude leaves, box appliance details and cloth with realistic details of the same sizes, without inventing furniture. View outside can be a soft leafy distant residential hillside, illustrative only. Correct exposure for a real camera: warm white stays neutral, sunlight from the actual balcony opening, clear shadow/contact detail, no cartoon look, no glossy orange wood, no fake ambient outlines. No people, no text, no UI, no watermark.
Specific view: Preserve this living-room view. Show the 85-inch TV on the left, large chaise sofa on the right, rounded pale-oak coffee table and separate ottoman, woven rug, low tea setting by the large glazing, plants, open laundry stack and office behind. Calm daytime with a little hidden warm light.
Output one clean photographic image in the same framing/aspect as Image 1. Distinctive marker: V20FULL-living-PHOTO.
